scripts.readme: npm run build && oclif readme --readme-path COMMANDS.md --no-source-links --no-aliases && prettier --write README.md COMMANDS.md
scripts.readme:check: npm run readme && git diff --exit-code README.md COMMANDS.md

audio.description: Classify and trim samples, split, make stereo, normalize and convert audio files

clean.description: Delete dependency and build output directories

cron.description: Explain cron patterns and list common ones

date.description: Convert and compare dates and timestamps

env.description: View and edit the env files in a project, like a monorepo's apps/*/.env

gen.description: Generate IDs, slugs, AWS ARNs, JWTs, IP and MAC addresses, hashes, passwords, secrets, lorem ipsum and fake data

jq.description: Query JSON with jq, find paths in it, compare it, and run common queries without writing jq

loc.description: Count the lines of code in a git repo, chart them over time, and see who wrote them

note.description: Jot down notes and snippets outside any repo, and copy them back later

org.description: Work with every repo in a GitHub org

port.description: See and stop what's listening on TCP ports

repo.description: Work with the repos in your GitHub account or an org

table.description: Fill out markdown tables for GitHub in the browser

worktree.description: List git worktrees, and remove them while checking out their branch in the main worktree

zsh.description: View and change the aliases, environment variables and PATH in your zsh startup files

zsh:alias.description: List, add and remove the aliases in your zsh startup files

zsh:env.description: List, set and remove the environment variables your zsh startup files export

zsh:path.description: See where each PATH directory comes from, and add or remove them
